topic: Mainz, Germany, around 1440: Johannes Gutenberg's printing press with movable metal type made books much faster to produce.

episode.title: Tiny Time Traveler: Gutenberg’s Big Idea

shots.narration: Golden sparkles! What’s that enormous wooden machine?
shots.scene: Sunlit historical printing workshop in Mainz, Germany, around 1440; wooden screw press, timber beams, vertical 9:16, rich 3D animation, no visible writing.
shots.action: Zoya materializes beside the press in swirling dust and golden sparkles.
shots.mood: Bright golden light, magical blue glow, friendly wonder.

shots.scene: Workshop doorway overlooking timber-framed buildings and a sunlit cobbled lane, vertical 9:16, no signs or writing.
shots.action: Zoya peeks through the open doorway.

shots.narration: [excited] This is Johannes Gutenberg’s printing press!
shots.scene: Tall wooden printing press inside the workshop, empty work area, vertical 9:16, detailed 3D animation, no visible writing.
shots.action: Tock points toward the wooden press.
shots.mood: Impressive wooden shapes, cheerful discovery, golden dust motes.

shots.narration: Its clever secret? Movable metal type.
shots.scene: Workshop bench with shallow trays of metal type, all character-bearing ends hidden from view, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Zoya lifts a metal type block with its smooth side facing the camera.
shots.mood: Curious close-up, sparkling metal edges, warm sunlight.

shots.narration: But this little piece has slipped out!
shots.scene: Wooden workbench with one loose metal type block beside an orderly tray, all type faces concealed, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Tock leans toward the loose block.
shots.mood: Gentle puzzlement, tiny robot tilted inquisitively.

shots.scene: Close view of a compartmented wooden type tray with an open space, smooth metal sides visible only, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Zoya holds the loose block above the tray.

shots.narration: There! Each little piece can move.
shots.scene: Sunlit workbench with a compartmented type tray, letter-bearing surfaces hidden, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Zoya returns the block to the open compartment.
shots.mood: Satisfying fit, bright smiles, friendly accomplishment.

shots.narration: The type could be rearranged and used again.
shots.scene: Workshop bench with adjacent trays of metal type, camera showing only smooth block sides, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Zoya transfers a block into another tray.
shots.mood: Clear visual discovery, warm wood and gleaming metal.

shots.narration: [surprised] No need to copy every page by hand!
shots.scene: Wooden printing press beside neat stacks of face-down paper, all printed surfaces concealed, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Tock spreads his tiny arms toward the paper stacks.
shots.mood: Wide-eyed delight, abundant paper, sunlit workshop.

shots.narration: Gutenberg’s press made books much faster to produce.
shots.scene: Workshop bench holding stacks of face-down sheets and closed books with plain covers and blank spines, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Zoya lifts a closed plain-covered book.
shots.mood: Proud discovery, rich leather texture, golden sunlight.

shots.narration: One little piece helped make a big difference.
shots.scene: Printing workshop with the wooden press behind Zoya, her blue wristwatch beginning to glow, vertical 9:16, no visible writing.
shots.mood: Triumphant warmth, blue light mingling with golden sparkles.

shots.scene: Sunlit workshop surrounded by gathering golden time-travel sparkles, Tock beside Zoya’s glowing blue wristwatch, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Tock bounces toward Zoya’s glowing watch as he asks his question.
shots.mood: Eager robot expression, swirling golden light, inviting adventure.

episode.endHook: Zoya’s watch glows again—where will their next adventure begin?
episode.description: Zoya and Tock time-jump to Mainz, Germany, around 1440 to explore Johannes Gutenberg’s printing press. A little workshop challenge reveals how movable metal type helped make books much faster to produce.
